GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 2 Lengths off, under rpessure turn and dropped out # poor/amiss?
Jumped Well Settled Down 3 Wide 3rd 2 Lengths 800m Outside Leader 2nd 1 Lengths home turn 2nd Under Pressure 2 Lengths Middle Of Track Kept Going Ok Straight # one paced run

Jumped Well sat box seat 2 Lengths off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 1 length off clear rails run, 1 length off 200m, squeezed/checked by leader passing 200m, held up/untested to the line, was 3rd across the line, elevated to 2nd after protest # held up/unlucky
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: 3rd past the post successfully protested against 1st past the post. Approaching the 150m was tightened for room  before being obliged to be severely checked near the 70m

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # Cardiac Arrhythmia
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr rep the mare raced ungenerously through the early and middle stages and failed to quicken when placed under pressure rounding the home turn. She said once it was out of contention over the final 250m, she did not pressure the mare any further. A post-race vet exam revealed the mare to displaying cardiac arrhythmia for the 1st occasion. Tnr was advised of the provisions of the Racing Australia Codes of Practice under AR88B(2)(b).

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , enjoyed good trail Two Wide With Cover behind speed 3 Lengths 800m, came off heels before the corner and soon after Straightening Up loomed to win, Just could not finish race off well enough last 100m but she held ground and not far off placing # even chase
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping was crowded between a rnr which shifted in and another rnr which was taken out by a rnr which shifted out. Approaching the 150m was bumped and carried wider by another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 2 Lengths off 3 Wide No Cover , ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, kept on ok after tough run # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start was crowded. Raced wide and without cover from near the 900m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 1.5L off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 1.5L off, found little and dropped out # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Rdr reported the filly raced flat and, in her opinion, has come to the end of its  preparation.  A post-race vet exam revealed no abs. Co-Trainer reported satisfaction with the filly's post race condition, however, will now be sent for a spell.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair pressed on to face breeze half off, pushed along a touch turn, joined in Straightening Up , headed passing 200m and kept on fairly to the line # had chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 2 lengths. 2nd turn 1 length. ran on strongly # too good
Jumped Fair 1-1 2 Lengths raced greenly early & middle stages home turn 3l Middle Of Track laying in stuck to task against dominant odds on winner 1.6l quicker thanbm64 # ok debut
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced greenly in the early and middle stages.
